prompt: Make one finished 3:2 landscape children's nonfiction illustration in the exact flat 2D clean bold-outline style of the attached reference. All essential subjects and diagram boundaries must sit at least 12 percent inside ALL four image edges; backgrounds may extend. Match the yellow bus design from reference: four square passenger windows, right-side front doorway and right-facing windscreen. Bridge deck continuously connects broad banks, with guardrails behind/below bus, bridge piers rise from water; bus tires visibly rest on road surface. Bus and bridge are framed widely with essential bus and bridge ends at least 15 percent inset. No other text or number, no people, no extra vehicles, no reference-board map, no extra floating museum. Simple green banks and pale blue sky.
